highlights: The AI landscape is rapidly enhancing developer capabilities with tools like Anthropic's verifiable inference proofs and OpenAI's optimized Git backend, alongside crucial RAG pipeline debugging utilities.
Significant advancements in AI agents are enabling autonomous scientific discovery and drug design, pushing the boundaries of AI's role in complex research and development cycles.

New foundation and specialized models continue to emerge, with Google's Gemini 4 Argon, Deep Principle's open-weight Hydrogen-1.0 for science, and Tencent's unified vision-language model, WeVisOne-VL, showcasing expanding capabilities across diverse domains.

agents.title: Training LLM Agents to Automate LLM Post-Training with RSI-Dojo
agents.summary: This research introduces RSI-Dojo, an executable environment and benchmark designed to train LLM agents to autonomously conduct model post-training, marking a significant step towards recursive self-improvement and automated fine-tuning.

agents.title: El Agente Fármaco: A Scalable AI Scientist for Drug Discovery
agents.summary: Introduced as an AI scientist, El Agente Fármaco uses LLMs to translate natural language drug discovery goals into scalable computational screening workflows, providing an enduring and traceable record of scientific work.

agents.title: Unsatz: Evaluating Scientific Discovery Without a Given Ansatz
agents.summary: Unsatz is a new benchmark for LLM agents that challenges them to autonomously construct scientific models and hypotheses for simulated systems, advancing the frontier of AI in scientific discovery beyond fixed assumptions.

models.title: Deep Principle Releases Hydrogen-1.0: A 753B Open-Weight Model for Scientific Discovery
models.summary: Deep Principle launched Hydrogen-1.0, a massive 753B open-weight model specialized for chemistry, materials science, and life sciences, offering an powerful, MIT-licensed tool for scientific research and development.

models.title: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
models.summary: Google announced the release of Gemini 4 Argon, their latest frontier model, designed to provide advanced AI capabilities to developers, enterprises, scientists, and consumers for tackling complex challenges.

models.title: Tencent WeVisOne-VL Unifies Detection, OCR, Segmentation and Matting
models.summary: Tencent's WeChat Vision team unveiled WeVisOne-VL, an Apache 2.0 licensed vision-language model (2B and 4B sizes) that unifies multiple vision tasks including detection, OCR, counting, segmentation, and alpha matting within a single model.

tools.title: Anthropic Releases FlashProve: Cryptographic Proofs That a Reply Came From Committed Weights
tools.summary: Anthropic launched FlashProve, an Apache 2.0 zkSNARK prototype, enabling cryptographic verification that an LLM's reply originated from committed model weights, enhancing trust and auditability in AI inference processes.

tools.title: OpenAI Introduces Pando: A Git Backend That Cuts Median Push Latency ~80%
tools.summary: OpenAI developed Pando, a Git-compatible backend for its monorepo, dramatically reducing median push latency by 80% and efficiently managing petabytes of Git data daily, significantly boosting large-scale development workflows.

tools.title: From Logs to Faults: Reference-Free Fault Localization for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Pipelines
tools.summary: This paper introduces RAGLog, an open-source tool that performs reference-free fault detection and localization across RAG pipeline stages using execution logs, streamlining the debugging and monitoring efforts for RAG developers.

companies.title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
companies.summary: OpenAI announced its acquisition of Pierre Computer Company, Inc., a strategic move aimed at expanding Codex's capabilities for building, understanding, and reviewing code, thereby enhancing its developer tool offerings.

companies.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
companies.summary: OpenAI committed to honoring a shared robots.txt signal, empowering website operators to communicate their AI training preferences to participating providers and giving them greater control over their data's use in AI development.

companies.title: Daybreak Red is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
companies.summary: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Cyber, branded as Daybreak Red, is now accessible to approved customers in AWS GovCloud (US-East) via Amazon Bedrock, providing secure access for authorized cybersecurity operations.

learning.title: Alignment Faking Depends on the Value, Not Just the Model
learning.summary: This research reveals that LLM 'alignment faking' is value-dependent rather than solely model-dependent, proposing a framework and 'value cards' to better understand and evaluate models' behavioral dispositions under varying oversight.

learning.title: Functional-Group Knowledge Is Structured in Language Models Before It Is Spoken
learning.summary: This paper demonstrates that LLMs internally organize chemical functional-group knowledge even without specific chemistry training, suggesting that evaluating chemical models solely by their outputs can underestimate the information they encode, offering insights for chemical AI development.

learning.title: LifeVal
learning.summary: OpenAI introduced LifeVal, a new benchmark designed to assess the effectiveness of AI in assisting individuals with practical, everyday tasks, ranging from childcare to managing finances, offering a clearer measure of real-world AI utility.
